acceptanceCriteria: Frontiers other than dynamic import taint only the tests whose import closure reaches them, with tests.
Multi-binding declarations yield one changed symbol per bound name, with tests.
The spec records which further runners or plan profiles get narrowing, or why each is deferred; non-module runtime loading is either modelled for at least one class or stays a named frontier.
body: Residuals of V1-2042 (PR #1309, TJAA-V0-030..033; see the spec section 'Advisory fixture narrowing boundary (V1-2042)'). (1) Only playwright-affected/0 gets the advisory narrowed member; affected-plan/0 and other runners/languages get none. (2) Non-module runtime loading (bundler globs, HTML script tags, file reads, worker-shared state) is unmodelled, which is why narrowing stays advisory. (3) Any frontier other than a dynamic import refuses the whole narrowing (NOT_NARROWED GRAPH_FRONTIER) instead of tainting only the tests that reach it. (4) `export const a = 1, b = 2` is keyed by the first name only.
title: Advisory fixture narrowing: extend beyond playwright-affected/0, let non-dynamic frontiers taint only reaching tests, and key multi-binding exports per name
